title: Fluid
description: Cell metadata for fluid simulation. Water cells may carry a water-type taxonomy (water_type, depth, flow_state); magma cells never do.

level.description: Fluid level for the single-type form.

water.description: Water level in the dual water+magma form.

magma.description: Magma level in the dual water+magma form.

depth.description: Depth level, stored explicitly and independent of fluid level. Water cells only.

flow_state.description: Flow state driven by inflow/outflow history. Water cells only.
